prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 13 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1267; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported impact forces, and the presentation fits the expected pattern for this type of trauma. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the shoulder injury. No prior injury to the same body region is known from the patient history. Conservative management was provided over thirteen visits, including manual therapy, graded therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction. Progress has been somewhat slower than typically seen with this injury, and the course of care has run a bit longer than usual, though the patient has continued to engage well with treatment. Billing records reviewed for this episode show no duplicate or repeated charges for services rendered. Ongoing rehabilitation and periodic reassessment are planned, with return to usual activities anticipated as strength and mobility improve.
